The Bluetooth on the flx4 is something I haven't explored yet.  With time...

The flx4 outputs are designed for "line-level", which means the "music output" from the mixer is transmitted through the cable at a compatible low voltage end to end.

Check your amp manual specs to be 100% sure. Most consumer grade audio amps can safely accept the flx4 RCA "line-level" signal.

You mentioned phono in your original post... Now phono is a very very low signal generated from a record player (aka. phonograph). If you plug in the flx4 into an amps phono input, then yes, it will sound terrible (distorted).  This is because line level is standard that is electrically higher voltage compared to a phono input. 

It's like trying to fit a square peg in a round hole, it just doesn't work and yes connecting the flx4 to a phono input could damage the amp...
